sentences.text: JUDGMENT

The present Civil Miscellaneous Appeal has been filed by the claimant challenging the award of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, seeking enhancement of the compensation arising out of an award passed by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Tirunelveli in M.C.O.P.No.1055 of 2013.

2. According to the claimant, he sustained the following injuries:
(i) Fracture over the pelvic bone (ii) Spleen was removed (iii) Fracture over the left side rib bones,
(iv) Fracture over the right side rib bones (v) Vein was cut over the throat (vi) Abrasion over the left leg knee.
3.
As per Ex.P18, the permanent disability has been arrived at 75%.
The Tribunal has accepted the same, but has awarded a sum of Rs.3,000/- (Rupees Three Thousand only) per percentage of the d i s a b i l i t y .

T h e l e a r n e d c o u n s e l a p p e a r i n g f o r t h e a p p e l l a n t s u b m i t t e d t h a t https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis the said amount has to be increased to a sum of Rs.4,000/-
(Rupees Four Thousand only) per percentage.

The learned counsel appearing for the appellant further pointed out that the claimant was originally admitted to Government Hospital at Puliyangudi and after first aid, he was taken for treatment to Shri Venkateshwara Hospital at Palayamkottai.
Thereafter, he was taken to treatment, in Galaxy Hospitals at Vannarpettai and for further treatment he was taken to Meenakshi Mission Hospitals at Madurai.
The learned counsel appearing for the appellant had relied upon the Exs.P2 to P.17 to contend that he was taking treatment as an inpatient in four different hospitals.
Therefore, the transport expenses awarded by the Tribunal at Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) on the lower side and he sought for enhancement.

4. Per contra, the learned counsel appearing for the respondent had contended that for loss of amenities, a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs only) has been awarded and for pain and sufferings a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) has been awarded and these amounts on the higher side may be adjusted and the total award amount may be confirmed.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
I have carefully considered the submissions made by the learned counsel on either side.

2 6.

Considering the nature of the injuries sustained by the claimant and the evidence of the Doctors,
viz., P.W.2 and P.W.3, I find that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal under the head of pain and sufferings or under the head of loss of amenities, are not excessive in nature and they cannot be interfered with.

7. The learned counsel appearing for the appellant had relied upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court in C.M.A.No. 3461 of 2017 (United India Insurance Company vs-Vignesh and another), dated 21.07.2022.

entities.text: C.M.A.No. 3461 of 2017 (United India Insurance Company vs-Vignesh and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the said judgment, the accident has taken place on 03.12.2013 and the Honourable Division Bench was pleased to award a sum of Rs.4,000/- (Rupees Four Thousand only) per percentage of disability.

Relying upon the said Division Bench judgment,
the learned counsel appearing for the appellant had contended that in the present case, the accident has taken place on 28.06.2013 and hence, the award of https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis the Tribunal may be enhanced at a rate of Rs.4,000/- (Rupees Four Thousand only) per percentage.

In view of the Division Bench judgment of the our High Court, this Court is of the considered opinion that a sum of Rs.4,000/- (Rupees Four Thousand only) can be awarded for each percentage of the disability.

8. As rightly contended by the learned counsel appearing for the appellant, the injured claimant has been shifted from one hospital to other hospital and he was an inpatient in at least four hospitals.
Therefore, the award of the Tribunal under the head of Transport Expenses as Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) is on the lower side.

Considering the fact that the petitioner's treatment at Puliyangudi, Palayamkottai, Vannarpettai and Madurai, this Court is of the opinion that the transport expenses would be enhanced from a sum of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) to Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only).
The amount awarded under the other heads are hereby confirmed.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 9
. The award under the head of permanent disability is enhanced from Rs.2,25,000/- (Rupees Two Laks Twenty Five Thousand only) to Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakhs only).
The Transport Expenses is enhanced from Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) to Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only).
Therefore the total compensation is enhanced from Rs.15,13,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakhs and Thirteen Thousand only) to Rs.16,28,000/- (Rupees Sixteen Lakhs and Twenty Eight Thousand only).
The enhanced amount shall carry interest at the rate of 7.5% from 25.11.2013 onwards.
The respondent Insurance Company is directed to deposit the enhanced amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
10. In view of the above said facts, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed to the extent as stated above.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
